# The other document

## The clock gate {#NEI-001}
<!-- ndf: kind=requirement modality=must refinement=L2 status=active -->

The clock gate MUST close on a halt.

## The schedule {#NEI-002}
<!-- ndf: kind=requirement modality=must refinement=L2 status=active -->

The schedule MUST be fixed at reset.
